source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/cote/cote (all 15 menu pages re-downloaded 2026-10-08, robots.txt allows /cote/)
notes: Independent regex re-read of all 541 dish records: every one of the 179 items.csv rows (173 published + 6 already held) matches its source record in all 7 nutrients and in contains/may-contain/cereals/nuts; the card's Contains/May-contain text agrees with the yes/may/no columns on all 541 records. Third check against each dish's own ingredient list found source contradictions, now held back: weekend gluten free Risotto Vert (x2) and Half/Whole Poulet Breton (empty allergen row but ingredients name milk/sulphites), Veggie French Onion Soup (celery), Andrea's Pasta (egg); plus sat fat > fat (Risotto Vert Vegan gf x2) and sugars > carbs (Botivo Spritz, Chocolate Mousse for One, Poulet Grille). Fixed: Caesar Salad (gluten free) no longer tagged vegetarian (page ticks vegetarian but marks fish, ingredient 'Anchovy'). Model limit noted in the chain note: where a dish contains one kind of tree nut/cereal the page may also list other kinds as may-contain and that cannot be shown.
